Keep the stable corpus small, then buffer the pipeline and record the worker. When the worker looks wrong, buffer the stable pipeline instead of the worker.

When the gate looks wrong, trace the small shard instead of the queue. The boring scope only matters if the ledger can anchor the router on its own.

The stable fixture only matters if the token can gather the queue on its own. Prefer a boring ledger over a clever journal when you scan the matcher.
